light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld home video shot by his grandson with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered cabin background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed and bright enough, the side near the snowy window brighter and cooler, the corners by the stove a little warmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, age spots and uneven tone; white hair and beard with stray hairs; flannel and canvas apron with real creases, soot and grease marks. People are caught mid-action, unposed. Bright snowy daylight from the window on the left plus the warm glow of the wood stove.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by his grandson with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the cabin in focus, only the light the place really has, bright and correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural old hands; he moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Now I'll tell you how you know when it's done. Take one bean out on a spoon and blow on it.
clips.action: He lifts the spoon of beans from the pot talking to the camera, then brings it close and blows on one bean. He wears the same dark green and black plaid flannel shirt, cream henley and tan canvas apron the whole time.

clips.text: If the skin curls back and peels, you're close. Then squeeze it against the roof of your mouth with your tongue.
clips.action: He pinches the bean showing the peeling skin to the camera, then pops it in his mouth and nods, chewing. He wears the same dark green and black plaid flannel shirt, cream henley and tan canvas apron the whole time.

clips.text: So, once they're tender, fish out the onion and the bay leaf, stir in a tablespoon or two of cider vinegar, and taste it for salt.
clips.action: He lifts the onion out of the pot with a slotted spoon talking, then pours a little vinegar into a tablespoon over the pot. He wears the same dark green and black plaid flannel shirt, cream henley and tan canvas apron the whole time.

clips.text: Alright. The hole in the ground. Bean-hole beans.
clips.action: Outside in the snow he leans on the shovel grinning at the camera, then points at the dirt mound. He wears the same dark green and black plaid flannel shirt, cream henley and tan canvas apron the whole time.

clips.text: And where are you cooking from tonight? I read every one of 'em. Now go put a pot on.
clips.action: Sitting at the table with his enamel mug he asks the camera warmly, then raises the mug in a small toast and winks. He wears the same dark green and black plaid flannel shirt, cream henley and tan canvas apron the whole time.
